Following a strong first season with critics and viewers alike, Apple has confirmed that ‘Margo’s Got Money Troubles’ will return for season two. Here are the details.

‘Margo’s Got Money Troubles’ renewed for season 2

Apple confirmed earlier tonight that ‘Margo’s Got Money Troubles’ has been renewed for a second season, ahead of next week’s finale.

‘Margo’s Got Money Troubles’ premiered last month to high critical acclaim, “quickly achieving a Certified Fresh rating on Rotten Tomatoes,” as Apple noted in its press release.

The series also received its first award nominations a few weeks ago, with Elle Fanning (Predator: Badlands) nominated for Outstanding Lead Performance in a Comedy Series, and Michelle Pfeiffer (Scarface) for Outstanding Supporting Performance in a Comedy Series at the 2026 Gotham Television Awards.

In addition to Fanning and Pfeiffer, the show also stars Nicole Kidman (The Hours), Nick Offerman (Parks and Recreation), and Greg Kinnear (As Good as It Gets).

Here’s the show’s synopsis on Apple TV:

The daughter of a former Hooters waitress and an ex-pro wrestler, Margo is a recent college dropout and aspiring writer. Faced with a new baby, mounting pile of bills, and dwindling number of ways to pay them, Margo must find a way forward.
